observations.summary: WaterSense bathroom sink faucets flow a maximum of 1.5 gpm at 60 psi, no less than 0.8 gpm at 20 psi; federal standard 2.2 gpm; at least 30 percent lower; many models 1.0 to 1.2 gpm; faucets must meet lead free requirements of ASME A112.18.1/CSA B125.1.
observations.inference_limit: Federal voluntary label specification; not a California code requirement.

observations.summary: SDWA lead free means a weighted average of 0.25 percent lead on wetted surfaces of pipes, fittings and fixtures; solder and flux 0.2 percent.
observations.inference_limit: Federal definition only; the post does not state an effective date.
